Page-face office: 'County Commissioner Seat A' (the sibling writes 'Utah County Commissioner Seat A'). FORM: the same NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 BLANK as the sibling (Schedule A columns Date / Name of Contributor / CITY AND STATE / Amount / IN-KIND; Schedule B with a real PURPOSE column; close box lettered G; six report types; 'Date of Filing' foliation field, so UNFOLIATED); modern_boxAF, 15-row boxed grids. No form-version string printed. FOUR PAGES, each classified from its own printed content because the photographs are CROPPED at the head and foot and the sheet headings are partly lost: p1 cover (loses the 'Name of Candidate' label band and the Date of Filing value), p2 SCHEDULE A (identified by its 'Total Contributions Received — Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report' footer and its In-Kind column header), p3 SCHEDULE B (identified by its 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages' footer and its Purpose column), p4 SUMMARY PAGE (loses the 'Summary Page' heading but prints boxes A-G): A 2,136.64 / B 400.00 / C 28,390.00 / D 98.66 / E 24,205.56 / F 2,536.64 / G 2,437.98. NO Elections-Division CHECKLIST is bound. REPORT TYPE: '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' ticked (she was eliminated in the June primary). AMENDMENT QUESTION: NEITHER 'No' NOR 'Yes' is ticked — a wholly unanswered honest BLANK, never read as 'No' (A4). Signed and dated 08/04/2022. The ladder closes exactly on this filing: A+B = 2,136.64+400.00 = 2,536.64 = F, and F-D = 2,536.64-98.66 = 2,437.98 = G — unlike the sibling report, whose close box does not follow its own printed formula. Box A here (2,136.64) is identical to the sibling report's Box G; recorded as an observation about the filer's own reporting chain — NOTHING was differenced across covers and no figure was carried between documents. ⚠ NEAR-DUPLICATE VERDICT (the `__2` filename suffix is an acquisition dedup marker, not a bundle and not an amendment): raw/2022/2022_Renee_Tribe.pdf (key 5afd8850) and this document are A DIFFERENT REPORT ENTIRELY, not a revision and not a second redaction pass. The row-level evidence: different report-type tick (Seven days preceding the Primary vs 30 Days after withdrawal or elimination), different report date (06/21/2022 vs 08/04/2022), different page count (6 vs 4), different binding rotation (rot 0 vs rot 270), and ZERO overlapping ledger rows — 23 contributions / 23 expenditures there against 2 / 1 here, with no donor, vendor, date or amount in common. Both documents' figures are independent and consistent with each other in the way successive per-period reports should be (this one's Box A equals that one's Box G; its Box C 28,390.00 exceeds that one's Box C 27,990.00 by exactly this report's 400.00 of new contributions), which CORROBORATES both readings without either being used to fill the other. Neither file is named _Redacted and neither carries a redaction bar; this one prints no street address anywhere in its ledger.
